decisions.statement: A member is put after the members the type already has.
A member takes the indent the member above it carries.
The type a member names is imported in the same answer.
A name the body imports from the path stated is not imported a second time.
A name the body imports from another path is refused rather than bound to that path.
A member is written optional where the change is told the member is optional.
A member the type has already is refused rather than carried twice.
The object type is found through the alias the change names.
An alias built from an intersection is read for the object type inside it.
A body with no such alias is refused.
A key no page spells is refused before any body is composed.
A type name no import holds is refused before any body is composed.
A type named from an empty path is refused.
The body is answered rather than written.
Nothing here puts the imports in order.
A type written on one line gains its member on that line rather than on a line of its own.

definition: one member put into an exported object type
